content.text: Final visual check of the two updated renders:

Done. Three PNGs rendered from one scalable template (`flyer.html`, driven by a `--s` scale variable):

| File | Size | Scale |
|---|---|---|
| `portrait.png` | 1080×1350 | 1.0 (master) |
| `wide.png` | 1200×1000 | 0.85 |
| `sky.png` | 300×600 | 0.28 |

How it holds up at every size:
- **Scaling** — every dimension (type, icons, paddings, band heights, avatar size) is `calc(Npx * var(--s))`, so all three are true scalings of the master rather than reflowed guesses.
- **Full-bleed bands** — the photo band and red CTA bar sit outside the horizontal padding, so they touch both edges at all three widths.
- **Photo** — `object-fit: cover` with a tuned focal point, so it crops (sky/hill/sun) and never distorts; same for the three circular candidate avatars.
- **Even columns** — candidates are `flex: 1 1 0` with a scaled gap; measured at portrait as 312 px wide at x = 46 / 384 / 722, perfectly even.
- **Vertical fit** — flexible spacers absorb the leftover height (sky has ~220 px extra because its canvas is proportionally taller), so each page fills exactly its canvas with no scroll (`scrollHeight` = 1350 / 1000 / 600).
- **Wide adaptation** — the extra width in the 1200×1000 crop puts the three steps in one row; each step is single-line (27 px tall, verified).
- **Verified clean** — a bounding-box audit on all headline, name, role, CTA, step, footer and column elements reported zero items clipped by the viewport, overflowing or overlapping at each size.
